plan.design_markdown:
# BW-13: Realign Panel 1 to Docs & Specs and Remove Duplicate EngineerChat

> **Status:** Ready  
> **Parent Epic:** `BW-12`  
> **Target Scope:** `benchwork` (`benchwork/web`)  
> **Key Invariants:**  
> 1. Hard 250 LOC rule on all `.ts` and `.tsx` files.  
> 2. Zero dead code: completely remove `EngineerChat.tsx` and obsolete chat hooks from Panel 1.  
> 3. Full architectural documentation fidelity: preserve multi-file markdown rendering, Chalkline doc generator links, and decision viewer.  

---

## 1. Overview & Objectives

Currently, Panel 1 is labeled "Panel 1: Spec Planner & /grill-me Chat" and embeds `EngineerChat.tsx` alongside `DocumentViewer.tsx`.
This creates massive redundancy with the sidebar chat rail and breaks brand conventions.

BW-13 accomplishes:
1. Replaces `GrillStudioPanel.tsx` with `DocsSpecsPanel.tsx`.
2. Updates primary navigation tabs in `App.tsx` from "Panel 1: Spec Planner" to "Panel 1: Docs & Specs".
3. Removes `EngineerChat.tsx` and unused chat state from Panel 1.
4. Expands the document viewer to occupy the full panel viewport with a clean sidebar file tree / tab strip for all 9 Chalkline architectural documents.

---

## 2. Component Layout & Refactoring

```text
benchwork/web/src/
├── App.tsx                     # Update panel tab definitions (<220 LOC)
└── components/
    └── panels/
        ├── DocsSpecsPanel.tsx  # Pure docs viewer and spec generator UI (<210 LOC)
        ├── DocumentViewer.tsx  # Markdown renderer with syntax highlighting (<240 LOC)
        ├── DecisionMatrix.tsx  # Storypole architectural decision table (<180 LOC)
        └── EngineerChat.tsx    # DELETED
```

---

## 3. Verification Steps

1. Verify Panel 1 renders cleanly without any chat input box or duplicate ping calls.
2. Verify switching between documentation tabs (`SPEC.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CONTRACTS.md`) functions smoothly.
3. Run `npm run build` in `benchwork/web` to ensure zero compilation or TypeScript errors.
